_comment: 'When this hits a hero, the next time they defend with 1 or more REACTION cards this turn, those cards have -1{d}' — the defence queue, on the OPPONENT, filtered to reaction cards. Piercing 1 and Go again are printed. The '1 or more ... those cards' plural is approximated as the next single reaction card blocked with: the queue is one-shot per card, so a multi-card block weakens only the first.
